_help: EDIT THIS FILE each season. The website and the booking server both read it, so prices always match. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD. Changes go live when pushed to GitHub (or with npm run deploy in worker/).
_onlineBooking: true lets guests book and pay online. Leave false until Stripe is set up; guests then get the inquiry form only.
_rateTiers: Weekly rate by check-in date. Each tier applies from its date until the next tier starts. EXAMPLE NUMBERS: replace with your real rates.
_taxPercent: Sales + occupancy tax added at checkout, e.g. 12.75. Confirm the correct rate with Dare County / NC before going live.
_maxGuests: Most guests allowed per booking (adults + children). 0 = no limit.
_requireTerms: Set to true once your rental agreement is linked in Stripe (Settings > Public details > Terms of service URL). Guests must then tick 'I agree' at checkout.
_venmoHandle: Your Venmo business profile, e.g. @ShortStackOBX. Leave empty to hide the Venmo option.
_booked: Check-in dates of weeks you've booked yourself, e.g. paid by Venmo: ["2027-07-03"]. These are also sent to Vrbo and Houfy through the booking server's calendar feed. Vrbo / Houfy / online bookings are added automatically.
